_comment: Every tool that declares reach anyone, with the reason it is safe: the in-code guard it relies on (callers list, presence proof, own-scope check, held at the Gate), or read-only. A tool with a mutating verb in its name needs a reason that names a guard; read-only does not count. PENDING reasons are tracked and shrink. test/reach-anyone.test.js fails on an anyone with no entry.

agents.ask.reason: guard() refuses non-assistant agent labels; modelMay refuses a plain mcp or harness caller with no verified thread or agent; sessions, the verified assistant, the person and modules pass (onboard asks as a module)

agents.create.reason: PERSON_ONLY at the socket peer check and the harness floor; modules call it for the person (see reach-person-only.json)

agents.history.reason: guard() plus modelMay: only the verified assistant, the person and modules read another agent's conversations, threads or usage; a session or a plain caller is refused

agents.list.reason: read-only: names, kinds and project grants; guard() refuses non-assistant agent labels

sessions.accounts.add.reason: askedOnly(): runs for a person's surface, on meta.asked, or for the verified assistant (meta.agent), which only STARTS an account: it covers the request's project only and is pending (never resolved, never a fallback) until the person finishes it on their own device; any other agent gets not_asked

sessions.accounts.bind.reason: askedOnly(): a non-person (the verified assistant, or on meta.asked) binds only to the project the request came from, never an agent, a default or '*', and never finishes a pending account; the person's surface sets anything wider and confirms any pending account

sessions.accounts.list.reason: read-only (an agent sees accounts without their vault item names)

sessions.accounts.signin.reason: askedOnly(): as add; a non-person starts a sign-in only for a new or still-pending account, scoped to the request's project, and the account stays pending after the sign-in, whoever completed it, until the person confirms it on their own surface (bind with confirm)

threads.archive.reason: own-scope check (sessionMay, core/switchboard): a plain mcp or harness caller with no verified thread or agent (the person's own Claude Code) starts threads and stops, archives or sends into only those it started (starter recorded by vyred), never deletes or rewinds; a session mutates only its own thread and the threads it started; a non-assistant agent hits guard() and mayReach; the verified assistant (meta.agent) and the person are not narrowed
